scope: The 120 Fresh, In-Training, Rookie and Champion source-sheet entries; metadata only. No artwork or lore paragraphs.
method: Ordinary public official English detail-page reads at a maximum one request start per 1.05 seconds/two reads in flight, plus official website search using its ordinary jQuery request. Existing verified roster URLs reused. No access blocks encountered; no bypass, image requests, or lore paragraphs in this artifact.
semantics: Official labels are separate from source-game labels. Numeric RPG level, four-element battle type, balance and prototype skill assignments are authored game data and are not supplied by these reference labels.
Special-move names are observed official labels, not copied lore or newly authored moves. No complete moveset, exclusive evolution edge or art license is inferred.
Visual sheets are not deduplicated. Dot variants and ambiguous era variants require separate source-game correspondence review.
An empty officialAttribute is observed absence in the official Attribute field, not Unknown, Free or an unresolved request. officialAttributeStatus distinguishes that case.
